answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake behind a walnut-sized hardware key: the key signs each transaction, and minting a new identity means buying a new key and posting a fresh deposit. An attacker building a canyon of fake accounts must pay for every key and every deposit, while honest agents reuse one key forever. Add a slow juniper-style reputation that only grows with verified work, so fresh identities start with zero trust and cannot outvote established ones.
